title: Installation
lead: Start a new project with the CLI, or add the two packages to a React 19 app you already have.

new-project.title: A new project
new-project.p1: `npm create skein` asks for a name, a template, a theme style and the features you want, and writes a Vite + React project:
new-project.p2: The `admin` template comes with a layout, menu, tabs, login, a dashboard and a users page. See the [Skein CLI](/cli) for every template and feature.

existing.title: An existing project
existing.p1: Install the components and the theme styles:
existing.p2: Import one theme style's CSS once, at the entry of the app, and wrap the app in `ConfigProvider`:

provider.title: ConfigProvider
provider.p1: `ConfigProvider` writes the theme state to `<html>`: `data-theme-style`, `data-mode`, `data-theme-color`, `data-theme-density`. It has to be on `<html>` because dialogs, popovers and selects are rendered into `<body>`, outside your app's element, and must follow the same theme.
provider.p2: It also takes `themeOverrides` (colours, radius, density), `locale` for the date components, and `labels` for the components' built-in texts. See [Theming](/theming).

language.title: Language
language.p1: Built-in texts (empty states, pagination, date pickers…) are English by default. Pass a language pack to `ConfigProvider` to change them:
